_meta.rationale: Linear resolves to DEFAULT_FREE_ALTERNATIVE. Follows the .a-button selector pattern of the three Phase 5 first-tuple buttons specs.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; return (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase().includes('linear'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['linear.app/logo', 'linear-logo', 'linear-mark', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.b-btn--primary, .a-btn'); if (!el) return true; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
